content:
sam_sales: Quick kickoff for Acme POC. They want SSO (SAML), SCIM sync, and RBAC mapping validated. Procurement asked for cost delta between hosted vs reserved.

rachel_se: thanks. Acme: ~900 users today, expect 2500 in 4 months. login QPS ~30 steady, spikes to ~120 during morning sync. main ask: role lookup at auth should be <40ms.

devon_idops: note: their AD has nested groups and some ad-hoc attributes (employeeType). mapping rules: nested groups should flatten to roles; need to support group->role mapping plus attribute-based filters. any constraints on number of groups per user? they can be up to 60.

priya_security: security checklist: require encrypted SAML assertions (AES-256), signed responses, and SAML Audience Restriction. Also want SCIM over mutual TLS if possible. They will need SCIM payload logging (redacted PII) shipped to their Splunk.

rachel_se: we support signed+encrypted assertions. For mTLS SCIM we can enable client certs on Dedicated or Private. Hosted supports TLS1.2+ and token auth; we can offer a temporary mTLS handshake for the POC if needed.

matt_proc: procurement: hosted is easier but asking about sustained price if they exceed 200rps for token ops. What are usual tiers?

rachel_se: hosted: default rate limits are 200 req/min for SCIM deltas and 500 rps for auth on free tier. For production-hosted we can raise AUTH rps to 1000 and SCIM to 1k/min with pricing uplift. Dedicated: fixed monthly sku (examples in quote) with predictable throughput and custom rate caps. I'll attach numbers.

sam_sales: Jordan from Acme prefers hosted for flexibility but procurement needs a worst-case estimate if they grow quickly. we should include a Dedicated break-even at 3 months in the quote.

devon_idops: technical blocker: nested groups flattening could cause explosion of role mappings. recommend we test with a sample export (CSV with group membership) in the sandbox. please ask Acme for a 200-user sample.

priya_security: logging: we will forward auth.success and scim.* events to Splunk via HTTP Event Collector. Need to confirm retention window and encryption-at-rest. Also ask legal for DPA and whether subprocessor list is acceptable.

rachel_se: DPA and SOC2 link: https://redwood.internal/compliance/SOC2 (internal) — lisa_legal will send public versions with the quote.

infra-bot: sandbox provisioned: env: acme-poc-sandbox-1805129999, expires in 14 days. creds will be DM'd to sam_sales and devon_idops.

matt_proc: will ask Acme to sign the NDA and share procurement contact. timeline: POC 2 weeks, with a dry run import + role mapping validation.

devon_idops: for SCIM bulk: we'll use pagination size 2k and initial import in off-peak. for deltas, we'll use ETag polling every 45s. can you whitelist 400 req/min for the POC please?

rachel_se: yes — we can whitelist SCIM delta to 400/min for 14 days. send the whitelist form.

priya_security: final note: Acme requires domain verification without DNS access for one of their brands. we can accept a signed SAML assertion from their IdP with a validated certificate chain + contact email domain ownership attestation. need to log and timestamp the verification.

sam_sales: next steps: (1) rachel to draft quote with hosted + Dedicated breakeven, (2) devon to upload 200-user sample CSV to sandbox, (3) priya to send security questionnaire link and required fields, (4) matt to share procurement contact and NDA. I'll follow up tomorrow with the quote draft. :thumbsup:
